He's also got a security researcher's eye — he found a bug in the project's $2,500 pizza game (a way to hit #1 with zero clicks) and openly shared the exploit instead of abusing it. On Discord he's a dependable helper too: 327 replies across 10 channels.

On X he's the one who defends @DlicomApp when FUD hits and rallies people around events like Pizza Day. Equal parts hype-man, moderator-energy and the glue holding conversations together. If the community has a backbone, it's him.
